mappings.basis: Unit 1 states residents may enter the lantern lottery, the target with the restricted actor folded in; unit 2 restates it with 'the lottery' for the same object.

mapping_doubts.note: Both units fold the RESTRICT population ('residents') into the assertion (narrower per M3); unit 2 shortens 'lantern lottery' to 'lottery' but plainly refers to the same object, so mapped as a duplicate direct.
